actions.detail: Preflight and WorkPreflight froze schema -> lease CAS -> fence -> checkpoint refs -> race tests; formal review remains pending while the local dependency projection is valid.
Added Job, Lease, and checkpoint metadata tables, monotonic fencing, active-lease uniqueness, database fence triggers, reference-only checkpoint repositories, and PostgreSQL race/rebuild tests.
Four isolated PostgreSQL tests passed on the first run with no failure, error, skip, or xfail.
Added P03-003 exact mode adapters without re-running the already-known generic placeholder failure; no Catalog or public contract change was made.

The first Security gate found one app-layer raw SQL fragment used only for a partial index predicate. The model now builds the same predicate with LeaseRecord.released_at.is_(None), removing text() without changing DDL or constraints.
152 unit/integration tests, 8 contract tests, lock/frozen sync, format, lint, type, secret, clock-contract, SCA, and licenses passed with mandatory_skip_count=0 and xfail_count=0.
